title: Pocket RPG Kit
intro: Build compact 2D tile RPGs for PocketJS with maps, events, battles, shops, saves, audio and a visual editor. Explore the feature gallery and example games in your browser.

showcase.title: Pocket RPG Kit Feature Town
showcase.description: Explore a miniature monster-RPG town built with Pocket RPG Kit. Fourteen playable halls turn screen effects, animated maps, character movement, battles, shops, streaming, saves, replay, sound and player registration into hands-on exhibits.

chapters.title: 1. Night Garden
chapters.description: Watch daylight fade through dusk, lightning, camera moves and title-card backdrops.

chapters.title: 2. Fountain Magic
chapters.description: Layer Tuxemon spell rings over tiles, actors and moving targets.

chapters.title: 3. Costume Workshop
chapters.description: Swap character art, translucent layers and live passage rules.

chapters.title: 4. Town Park
chapters.description: Meet wandering, running and approaching characters on controlled routes.

chapters.title: 5. Oracle's Room
chapters.description: Try extension-owned choices driven by live game state.

chapters.title: 6. Tuxemon Arena
chapters.description: Fight Bamboon with Bigfin through win, loss and escape branches.

chapters.title: 7. Market Square
chapters.description: Buy and sell items while finite stock and the party wallet update.

chapters.title: 8. Endless Grove
chapters.description: Walk through streamed chunks, animated water and tall sprites.

chapters.title: 9. Portrait Library
chapters.description: Switch dialog themes live and meet portrait-bearing speakers.

chapters.title: 10. Cutscene Stage
chapters.description: See input locks and world-idle gates coordinate a small scene.

chapters.title: 11. Post Office
chapters.description: Export a real save code and verify its round trip in the Save Menu.

chapters.title: 12. Tour Pavilion
chapters.description: Let the guided tour play, take control, then rewind three seconds.

chapters.title: 13. Sound Studio
chapters.description: Mix town music, ambience, fanfares and sound effects on one clock.

chapters.title: 14. Registration Desk
chapters.description: Register a player name with the built-in name-input scene, then see it used in later dialogue.

controls.action: Walk through the gallery and enter a hall

wander.title: Wander: an Endless Grown World
wander.description: An unbounded world streamed in 32×32 chunks around the player: towns grow as you reach them, and chunks load ahead and unload behind within a fixed memory cap. Left alone it wanders by itself; the minimap shows the rings.

controls.action: Walk. Any key takes over from the auto-walk; 10 idle seconds hand it back.
Fast travel on or off (TRI on screen)

wander.pointer: Click or tap a tile to walk there.

wander-online.title: Wander Online
wander-online.description: A shared multiplayer world: sign in with GitHub, create a character, and walk with others in real time.

sunstone.title: The Sunstone of Bramble Hollow
sunstone.description: A three-map adventure through a village, a forest and a cave. Leave it alone for 10 seconds and it plays itself; press any key to take over.

controls.action: Walk, pick an answer. During the demo, any key takes over.

grow.title: Rule-Grown Settlement
grow.description: Four settlements grow to the right from one seeded rule set. Scrub back to any moment, then walk into the finished village.

controls.action: Step the timeline back or forward
Pause or resume growing (TRI on screen)
Walk into the finished village; talk

grow.pointer: Drag along the timeline strip at the bottom of the screen to scrub.

meadow.title: Mini Meadow
meadow.description: The minimal example: one 20×12 map and four events, driven by the session reducer by hand.

preview.title: Project Preview
preview.description: The rpgkit-preview/v1 host: another page embeds this player and hands it a project document over postMessage — load, start at a tile, read state, inject input, stop. Try it on the preview protocol demo page.

editor.title: Pocket RPG Kit Editor
editor.description: Runs on PocketJS, so the same editor also runs on the desktop and on devices. Edit maps and events with the mouse and keyboard, then play-test them immediately. Open a local project or start from Sunstone or Meadow; saves stay in this browser until you download the JSON.

controls.action: Try the current map, then return to the same edit history

editor.pointer: Click or drag to paint and select; right-click or Shift-click to erase. EVENT opens event editing and text fields.

studio.title: Pocket RPG Kit Studio
studio.description: A full map and event editor for the browser: zoom and pan large maps, paint with brush, rectangle and fill, edit event pages and command trees with forms, undo with history, and save to this browser or download. It edits the same files with the same operations as rpgkit-edit.

showcase.title: Pocket Tuxemon
showcase.description: Tuxemon's world imported automatically into Pocket RPG Kit: maps, NPCs, dialogue, shops and real battles, from Spyder's bedroom through Paper Town to Route 1. It lives on its own site; Tuxemon's art and story are GPL-3.0 / CC BY-SA.
